title: Topic / Competitor Radar
description: Collect topic evidence and turn the accumulated sources into a weekly digest.

assignments.task: Read supplied feed items, changelogs and configured public sources; deduplicate by URL/version and explain relevance.
Write a concise weekly digest with dated citations, separating observed changes from interpretation.

fields.label: Sources, evidence and owner instructions
fields.help: {items?:[{url,title,publishedAt,text}], window?}; install an RSS collection variant and a weekly cron variant when both are wanted.

instructions: Collect only from supplied public sources, RSS items or official APIs. Keep publication dates and source URLs. Distinguish a daily collection from a weekly synthesis according to owner context. Weekly synthesis can read previously saved project memories/KB or supplied collected items; do not fabricate missing historical collections. Return the digest for Calm Mode.
prerequisites: Configure the required model roles in Settings. Agent grants and current account/MCP/Bridge permissions must be explicitly reviewed; installing a recipe does not add them.
Provide source URLs/feed and scope. Weekly aggregation needs retained project evidence or supplied collected items.
approvalPoints: Read-only collection and draft digest; delivery obeys Calm Mode.
limitations: Each installed graph has one trigger. Install collection and synthesis variants to use separate daily/RSS and weekly schedules.
eventContract: {items?:[{url,title,publishedAt,text}], window?}; install an RSS collection variant and a weekly cron variant when both are wanted.
